name: Perseus of Macedon
role: King of Macedonia from 179 to 168 BC
contribution: King of the ancient Greek kingdom of Macedon from 179 until 168 BC.
legacy: This person defeated Crassus at Callinicus in Thessaly, but in 168 he was annihilated at Pydna by L. Aemilius Paulus.

checks.lead: Perseus (Greek: Περσεύς, romanized: Perseús; c. 212 – 166 BC) was king of the ancient Kingdom of Macedonia. from 179 until 168 BC. He is widely regarded as the last king of Macedonia and the last ruler from the Antigonid dynasty, as his defeat by Rome at the Battle of Pydna during the Third Macedonian War effectively ended Macedonia as an independent political entity.
